cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(WindowSystemLuaExternalContract LANGUAGES CXX)
find_package(WindowSystem CONFIG REQUIRED)
set(BUILD_TESTING OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(LUA_RUNTIME_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory("${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../../../lua-runtime" lua-runtime)
add_subdirectory("${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../.." window-system-lua)
add_executable(external-lua-contract main.cpp)
target_compile_features(external-lua-contract PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
target_link_libraries(external-lua-contract PRIVATE WindowSystemLua::Host)
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME window-system.lua-external-contract COMMAND external-lua-contract)
set_tests_properties(window-system.lua-external-contract PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 15)
